meats.text: We partner with your insurance agent to make sure you get every dollar your policy covers. Our IKO Certified team documents every impact point with photos and detailed reports — the exact evidence your adjuster needs. Homeowners who contact us before closing their claim consistently qualify for full restoration coverage.

Hidden storm damage is the number one reason homeowners lose on insurance claims. Granule loss, bruising, and micro-fractures are invisible from the ground but critical to your settlement. We coordinate directly with your insurance company from inspection through completion — handling all the paperwork so you don't have to.

Pineapple Contractors is IKO Certified with an RCAT license — that means your restoration meets the highest industry standards. We've completed hundreds of full restorations across the region. Every project is backed by manufacturer warranties and our own workmanship guarantee.

Your roof is your home's first line of defense. After a storm event, every day you wait allows water intrusion to compound the damage. A roof claim can become a structural claim fast. Our complimentary inspection identifies every issue and gives you a full report to present to your insurance company.

We help homeowners and insurance agents work together to get your roof restored correctly. Our process is simple: complimentary inspection, detailed damage report, insurance coordination, and full installation by our IKO Certified crew. From first call to final nail — we manage everything.
